macro_cross_check.verdict: BREAK, CALLED OUT LOUDLY - AND THE RECIPE FAILS THE RUN'S CALORIE FLOOR. Protein -18.9% is outside the 15% instrument, so every line was re-examined: ALL quantities are absolute printed amounts (1 lb, one 14.5 oz can, 1/2 cup) - no each-weight assumption exists to correct. The published 41 g/serving x 4 = 164 g protein is UNREACHABLE from the printed quantities: turkey 85 g (93/7 label) + parmesan 20 g + drained cannellini 20 g + everything else ~8 g = ~133 g max (33.3/serving). Reading 'lean' as 99/1 turkey breast raises protein to only 38.4/serving (-6.3%) while dropping calories to ~326 (-22.7%), reproducing the label even worse. The source's auto-calculated label is inflated across the board (its own macro line sums to ~437 cal); our label-accurate recompute is the honest number, and that number is 376 cal.
macro_cross_check.band_check: FAIL: computed 376.3 cal/serving is BELOW the run's 400-cal floor (and the alternative 99/1 turkey reading is 326, further below). Carbs 23.9 g <= 35 PASS. This recipe cannot meet the [400, 650] band from its printed quantities under label-accurate math; the published 422 that got it selected is not reproducible. Mapping and pricing are complete and sound, but spec/QA must treat the band as failing - flagged here so the failure is caught at the gate, not on a published card.

board_defects_observed: ingredient-map.json entry 'Spinach' -> frozen-chopped-spinach is a FRESH->FROZEN form-flip that predates the board's fresh 'spinach' commodity; update-recipes-db.ps1 stamps from ingredient-map first, so at stamp time the fresh line would be re-priced as frozen. Same defect logged by creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet; needs the map correction through the match-soundness gate BEFORE this recipe's stamp pass.

ingredient-map.json entry 'Green Bell Peppers' -> green-bell-pepper references an id that no longer exists in commodities.json; live id is bell-peppers (cheapest cells are green bells, class-sound for green lines). Map repoint needed through the gate.
ingredient-map.json entry 'Cannellini Beans' -> cannellini-beans, but the weekly resolver claims the term for canned-white-beans; one id should own the concept at the gate.
